entities.summary: India is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is New Delhi. Official languages include Hindi, English. Government: Federal parliamentary constitutional republic. Population: approximately 1440.0 million. Area: 3,287,263 km². Comprehensive index for India covering Indus Valley civilisation, Vedic period, Maurya Empire (Ashoka), Gupta golden age, Chola/Pallava/Rashtrakuta southern kingdoms, Delhi Sultanate, Vijayanagara Empire, Mughal Empire, Maratha Confederacy, European trading companies, British Raj, independence movement (Gandhi, Nehru), Partition 1947, republic, Green Revolution, liberalisation 1991, nuclear power, IT revolution, and Modi era.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: India's independence movement led by Gandhi and Nehru had a profound impact on the continent, inspiring non-violent resistance movements worldwide. The country's economic liberalization in 1991 transformed its economy into one of the fastest-growing in the world.
